correctness.rationale: Complete absorbing CTMC definition, almost-sure first type extinction and species neutrality. Reflection and species interchange give P_E=1-P_C and P_S=1/2. The only two remaining reachable nonabsorbed states obey exactly (mu+1+c)x=1+cu and (mu+2)u=1+x+mu/2; solving yields the claimed rational expression. Its strictly positive denominator and numerator c-(mu-1)(mu+2) prove every strict region and tie; exact full-state 12-state rational elimination independently matches at 81 pairs. No finite sample is used to prove the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: A minimal nontrivial landscape with one central and two peripheral patches permits a complete, parameter-uniform location ranking for the stochastic first-extinction competition objective. The explicit threshold quantifies a natural tradeoff between topological colonization access and central patch loss, and supplies a benchmark where always favoring the higher-degree patch is demonstrably wrong. Every initial placement class is included, not an arbitrary isolated rate instance. This is an exact small-system result, not a claim about field interventions or a large-network theorem.
